description: The official governing document of ASSAUD, outlining the association’s objectives, membership, leadership structure, responsibilities, governance procedures, and operational guidelines.

chapters.title: Name and Objectives
sections: The association shall be known as the Actuarial Sciences Students Association of the University of Dar es Salaam (ASSAUD).
Its registered office shall be located at Mwalimu J.K. Nyerere Mlimani Main Campus.
The association aims to promote the actuarial profession, strengthen academic and professional relationships, keep students informed about industry developments, and represent their interests.

chapters.title: Membership and Activities
sections: Membership is optional and open to students enrolled in the Actuarial Science degree programme at the University of Dar es Salaam.
Members are required to pay an annual subscription fee determined by the Executive Committee.
Association activities include professional talks, seminars, workshops, and academic and social events with students from other universities.

chapters.title: Office Bearers and Responsibilities
sections: The association shall be governed by an Executive Committee consisting of the President, Vice President, Secretary General, Head of Finance, Head of Academic Affairs, Head of Organizing and Events, and Head of Public Relations and ICT.
The President provides leadership and represents the association, while the Vice President assists and deputizes the President.
The Secretary General manages documentation and meetings, while the Head of Finance oversees financial records and budgets.
Other office bearers oversee academic welfare, event coordination, public relations, website management, and electronic communications.

chapters.title: Elections and Term of Office
sections: Executive Committee elections shall be held annually towards the beginning of the second semester.
Elections shall be conducted through secret ballot under the supervision of the Chief Returning Officer.
Candidates must be registered and fully paid-up members and meet the eligibility requirements outlined in the constitution.
The Executive Committee shall serve for one academic year, with officials eligible for re-election for a maximum of two terms.

chapters.title: Meetings and Committees
sections: General meetings shall be held at least twice each semester, with two-thirds of the membership constituting a quorum.
The President or Vice President shall preside over general meetings.
Consultative and extraordinary meetings may be convened in accordance with the constitutional procedures.
The association may establish committees whenever necessary to address specific matters.

chapters.title: Finances and Code of Conduct
sections: The Head of Finance shall oversee the association's finances, maintain financial records, and prepare budgets.
Association funds shall be maintained in an account, with authorized signatories required for withdrawals.
Budgets and financial reports shall be presented to members at the beginning of each semester.
The constitution provides procedures for votes of no confidence, resignation, suspension, and replacement of office bearers.

chapters.title: Amendments, Dissolution and Patrons
sections: Constitutional amendments shall be considered at a general meeting and require a two-thirds majority vote of the total membership.
The constitution provides procedures for normal dissolution and dissolution through a vote of no confidence.
The association shall have two patrons: an Internal Patron from the University and an External Patron with an actuarial background who is not employed by the University of Dar es Salaam.
The patrons shall oversee the association's activities and provide guidance to its members.
